entries.title: Robot Arm Clay Sculptor
entries.description: A robotic arm with a spherical tool presses, drags, and smooths a soft, color-changing clay block (a deformable mesh) on a pedestal, leaving trails and bumps that slowly relax while a ghost “target shape” outline hovers transparently behind it.

entries.title: Falling Blocks Self-Assembling Statue
entries.description: Colorful cubic blocks fall from above, bounce on a platform, and magnetically attach in pre-defined positions to gradually assemble a labeled 3D statue, with misaligned blocks detaching and re-falling until they fit.

entries.title: Sand Grain Drip Sculpture
entries.description: Thousands of tiny spheres drip like sand from a nozzle, pile up into a conical heap, then slide and avalanche to form a smoothed sand sculpture, with a slider controlling drip rate and a transparent box showing the bounding volume.
entries.seed: Sand Grain Drip Sculpture: Thousands of tiny spheres drip like sand from a nozzle, pile up into a conical heap, then slide and avalanche to form a smoothed sand sculpture, with a slider controlling drip rate and a transparent box showing the bounding volume.

entries.title: Ice Sculpture Melting and Refreezing
entries.description: A clear, faceted ice statue slowly melts into droplets that detach and fall into a tray, while a moving cold “freezer beam” passes over sections to re-freeze water back into crystalline shapes, with color gradients showing temperature.

entries.title: Wireframe Armature Growing a Statue
entries.description: Thin metallic rods (cylinders) grow, extend, and branch from a base point to form a wireframe armature of a human figure, then translucent “clay” surfaces inflate between rods, snapping, stretching, and reattaching as they shift.

entries.title: Particle Swarm Carving a Block
entries.description: A transparent cube of “stone” is eroded by a swarm of colored carving particles that orbit and dive into the block, removing tiny chunks and leaving a gradually emerging inner sculpture, with dust particles drifting away.

entries.title: 3D Printer Sculpture Builder
entries.description: A printer head moves in a raster pattern over a platform, extruding thin layers of semi-transparent plastic that stack to form a complex sculpture, with each layer briefly glowing as it’s deposited and a vertical progress meter on the side.

entries.title: Magnetic Bead Sculpture Clustering
entries.description: Dozens of metal beads float in a low-gravity chamber, colliding and snapping together via colored magnetic poles to form evolving abstract sculptures, then occasionally repel and reconfigure when a rotating field source moves around them.

entries.title: Fluid Marble Sculpture Erosion
entries.description: A marble block sits in the path of a directed particle stream of water droplets that collide, chip off small fragments, and slowly carve flowing channels and cavities, with eroded dust clouding the water and settling in a transparent basin.

entries.title: Lego-Style Modular Sculpture Factory

entries.title: Origami Sheet Folding into a Sculpture
entries.description: A thin square sheet (mesh) lies flat then folds along pre-marked lines, with edges snapping and aligning to form a 3D paper sculpture, while arrows and labels show active folds and a transparent “target” silhouette shows the final form.

entries.title: Crystal Growth Sculpture in Solution

entries.title: Voxel Statue from Collapsing Grid
